title: Align repair finalLines with physical line count
description: From the 2026-08-15 complete code audit: `repairEventsJsonl` reports `finalLines` as the count of non-empty rebuilt lines (src/core/repair.ts:98) while the file actually contains `rebuilt.length` physical lines (any empty lines included). Cosmetic metric inconsistency in the `waystation repair` summary. Align the reported metric with the physical line count (or document why non-empty is the contract).
acceptance: `finalLines` in the repair result matches the physical line count of the rewritten events.jsonl.
Existing repair behavior (split concatenated lines, trailing-newline normalization) is unchanged.
All checks green: `bun test`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run check`, `waystation validate`.
